metadata.title: Lululemon plunges after outlook cut, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
3 hours ago
Lululemon plunges after outlook cut, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in premarket action:
Lululemon shares sank 18% following the athleisure-wear retailer's cut of its revenue outlook for the year by between 5% ad 7%.
AMC Entertainment surged 14% after CEO Adam Aron lashed out at Robinhood Markets in a post on X late Thursday for the online trading platform's tokenized version of the movie-theater chain's shares. "We have no connection to this at all, and do not condone it in any way," he wrote. Robinhood's stock declined by almost 1%.
Chip stocks climbed again, set to extend their rally from the previous session as sentiment among investors remains positive for semiconductor stocks. Intel and Micron Technology rose nearly 2%, while Nvidia was up about 1%.
Software company UiPath tumbled 10% despite posting strong results and raising guidance for the year as traders appeared to express caution for the road ahead.
